question: Ticket e41a94da3fd0 touches outline section 3.3, where Q#7 stands open: "Ideas, intents and questions (the open-question lane) are not tickets today, but each is born, followed and closed. Kinds of Ticket, or their own thing? See 19.18 (question tool)." What is the answer?
why_it_blocks: the ticket works inside outline section 3.3, and the answer to Q#7 may change it
answer: ideas are just notes that lead to intentions. they're not important once the intention is set down. same with questions. once they're answered, only the answer is important most of the time. if we need more than the answer, we don't need the question, we need the why. the only reason to have the question is to deduce the why. if we have the answer and the why, nothing else matters.
